newsitem.title: USA: NY state comptroller warns against taking on debt.
newsitem.headline: NY state comptroller warns against taking on debt.

text.p: The New York State comptroller on Tuesday, saying Gov George Pataki's new budget for fiscal 1998 was "economically optimistic," faulted it on several other grounds, including financing proposals.

"...The governor's capital plan proposes to decrease pay-as- you-go capital financing from 37 percent to 21 percent by increasing back-door borrowing. As a result, state debt service will grow to more than 10 percent of the budget within three years," said H. Carl McCall, in prepared remarks.
